messages:
marta: quick microcopy check — multi-select 'discard drafts' modal feels a bit clunky. want a fast sanity check before i ping PM. current copy below.

marta: Current copy:
Title: Discard changes?
Body: You're about to discard changes on 3 drafts. This cannot be undone.
Primary: Discard
Secondary: Cancel

marta: TL;DR: prefer something clearer about what will happen and uses the plural var {n}. Also want the primary CTA to be explicit (verb + object).

devon: +1 on explicitness. 'Discard' alone is vague in multi-select contexts. also consider tone — less alarm, more clarity.

devon: quick alt idea:
Title: Delete selected drafts
Body: This will permanently delete {n} unsaved drafts. This action can’t be undone.
Primary: Delete drafts
Secondary: Keep drafts

samir: i like that. a couple nit picks: use consistent verb (Delete vs Remove), and make the primary verb negative only if it matches other flows. we use "Delete" elsewhere for permanent removal.

samir: alternative (short):
Title: Remove {n} drafts?
Body: Removing these drafts will permanently delete their unsaved changes.
Primary: Remove {n} drafts
Secondary: Cancel

olivia: accessibility note: primary button should include the noun (eg "Delete drafts") so screen readers have context. avoid generic labels like "Yes" or "Discard". also add an inline clarifying sentence for larger counts: "This affects {n} items."

olivia: UI nit: for small counts show exact number: "Delete 3 drafts". for large counts use "Delete selected drafts" to avoid long strings.

design-bot: a11y checklist: focus moves to modal heading on open, primary is keyboard-focusable, confirmation dialogs should not rely on color alone. if we keep the "can't be undone" line, pair it with a softer lead-in: "This action is permanent."

marta: thanks — these are great. leaning to this final wording (friendly + explicit):

Title: Delete selected drafts
Body: This will permanently delete {n} selected drafts and their unsaved changes. This action can’t be undone.
Primary: Delete drafts
Secondary: Keep drafts

marta: i'll update the Figma and send a short copy ticket. if anyone objects, drop a reaction or reply by EOD. otherwise i'll push to PM for sign-off. :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup:

samir: :+1:

olivia: looks good to me. one tiny ask — add aria-label on primary: `Delete {n} drafts` so it reads the count on screen readers.

marta: added to ticket. thanks all!
